conduct_outside_employment_001.evidence: 17.1 No certificated position for credit classes in the Adult and Community Schools shall be filled by a teacher not employed by the District during the regular school term if there is a qualified applicant for such position who is employed by the District during the regular term.
conduct_outside_employment_001.coder_notes: Updated from not_discussed. Article 17 explicitly addresses and regulates outside employment in adult/community school credit classes, restricting it by prioritizing current District employees.

conduct_drug_alcohol_003.evidence: 15.1 Documentation regarding improper teacher conduct in the following areas will remain in the file: ... Conduct involving drugs or alcohol.
conduct_drug_alcohol_003.coder_notes: Updated from not_discussed. Section 15.1 mentions drug/alcohol conduct only tangentially in the context of personnel file retention, not as a comprehensive workplace policy or rule.
